name: Should I hire a framing specialist or a full-scope remodeling contractor?

mainEntity.name: Should I hire a framing specialist or a full-scope remodeling contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hiring an owner-operated general contractor like HH Remodeling LLC gives you direct oversight and seamless trade coordination from start to finish. When Abraham Becerra leads the framing on-site, the work is tailored directly to the upcoming drywall, painting, and tile phases handled by his crew. For specialized trades like electrical and plumbing, he coordinates trusted sub-trades directly, eliminating communication gaps. This single point of contact prevents scheduling delays, controls labor costs, and ensures accountability across every phase of your Denver-area remodel without dealing with multiple independent subcontractors.
acceptedAnswer.description: A full-scope contractor ensures framing is built specifically to accommodate mechanical rough-ins, drywall, and finish carpentry with a single point of accountability.
